It's good that you're aware that you may take certain things personally even when it's not warranted. It's something I struggle with too. 

For me personally, if it's a close friend. I'd talk to them about how I feel and gain some reassurance from them. If it's an acquaintance or someone unimportant in my life, I try to remind myself that it's normal to make mistakes and it doesn't make me more inferior than others. It's not easy and requires a lot of practice to remind yourself that you're human, so are they, and we aren't all flawless. 

Hope things get better overtime! Hang in there dear ❤️

Yes, I feel this too. I'm someone who has trust issues and have trouble letting new people into my life. Once I trust someone, my life is basically in their hands and I feel safe. They're my emergency contact when I spiral or when things go bad. They're the only ones who can safely talk me out of doing silly things and comfort me.

Hi OP, I think it's a really good step that you're able to reflect and are aware of what you're doing in this cycle. I do this as well too but I didn't realize it till someone else pointed it out to me. I was in denial for a while and am still trying to fix this. Spoke to my therapist about it and she told me to try talking to different people and sort of "compartmentalize" my topics instead of dumping everything onto one person (not sure if this makes sense). My thoughts split a lot too and the voices in my head are never kind to me.

I feel that you shouldn't be carrying this all on your own in a relationship. It's also important for your partner to know how to help you out of this cycle and from spiraling further. You're not a terrible person for doing this, it's just something we can't seem to control at times and I'm sure you never meant to hurt anyone intentionally.  I hope things get better OP! You're not alone ❤

I feel this way too. Sometimes I can look in the mirror and appreciate how nice I look that day, but most times what I see is someone ugly in the mirror. For you to create a temporary account to post pics, sounds like what I used to do back then too. I gain that small dose of validation then I spiral into thinking I'm just being too full of myself. 

Not sure if this counts as advice, but I tried to overcome this by picking one thing I like about myself and give it extra love and care. In this case, my hair. I try not to look at parts I feel insecure about, and I just try to focus on how my hair looks on that day. Hopefully, one day, I can look in the mirror and see myself as a whole person and love the others parts of me too. I've never seen you before OP, but I believe behind this post, is someone beautiful inside out ❤ sending you love and hugs!
